title: Ryan Seacrest sells 40-acre Napa Estate for $18.5M after $22M asking price
summary_full: In a notable real estate move, Ryan Seacrest has sold his stunning Napa Valley estate for eighteen point five million dollars. Spanning forty acres, this meticulously renovated property was purchased by him for fourteen million dollars in two thousand twenty. The estate showcases a sprawling ten thousand seven hundred fifty square foot main house, complete with exceptional amenities, signaling the end of Seacrest's notable investments in Napa.
